newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil little changed, await fresh data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil little changed, await fresh data.

text.p: The Malaysian palm oil market was little changed in early trading, as the Chicago soyoil futures market had been closed for the Independence Day holiday in the United States on Friday, traders said.

They said price movements were restricted with players waiting for the release of fresh estimates from forecaster Ivan Wong later on Monday. "It was a very quiet morning," said a trader. He added interest would remain low until the release of the Ivan Wong data.
AT 0335 GMT, the September futures contract was rose one ringgit at 1,168 ($462.66) a tonne.
